title: 13 Best Herbal Tinctures For Throat Irritation
intro: Herbal tinctures for Throat irritation are concentrated plant extracts that have been used for centuries to soothe and calm irritated throats. Other herbal tinctures such as Marshmallow Root, Mullein, and Throat Coat also provide effective relief from throat irritation, making them a popular choice among those seeking natural remedies.
